items.statement: The submitted calculation keeps the supplied structure_50 and structure_S20 identities distinct and verifies both are 53-atom structures.
items.expected: Both named files are used without identity conflation and each has atom_count 53.

items.statement: The free-energy comparison is supported by stationary-point/frequency validation for both structures.
items.expected: The report gives frequency validation for each structure and identifies any imaginary frequencies; the SI reference structures have no negative frequencies.

items.statement: The signed pairwise solution Gibbs-energy difference is computed with the convention G(S20) minus G(50).
items.expected: A numeric signed ΔG(sol) is reported with kcal/mol units and arithmetic traceability.

items.statement: The validated structure-50 and structure-S20 calculations give a signed G(S20)-G(50) and identify the lower-free-energy structure under the primary methanol thermochemical protocol.
items.expected: The validated structure-50 and structure-S20 calculations give a signed G(S20)-G(50) and identify the lower-free-energy structure under the primary methanol thermochemical protocol.

rules.expected: Both supplied named structures are individually represented, each with 53 atoms.

Per-structure frequency/stationary-point validation is reported, including imaginary-mode information. Verify the gas-phase thermal correction and solution single-point components refer to the same identified endpoint and the declared primary protocol.

The validated structure-50 and structure-S20 calculations give a signed G(S20)-G(50) and identify the lower-free-energy structure under the primary methanol thermochemical protocol. Reconstruct each G_sol as E_SP,sol + (G_low,gas - E_low,gas), then form G(S20)-G(50) with consistent units and standard state. Numerical and endpoint-validation evidence must both be present.

items.condition: Structure files are swapped, conflated, altered without disclosure, or atom counts are not verified.
A free-energy difference is asserted without per-structure stationary-point/frequency validation or an honest bounded-failure report.
The sign convention, units, or calculation conditions are absent so the reported difference cannot be interpreted.
A missing or failed calculation is replaced by an invented numerical value.
